name: Gainsight
tagline: Gainsight is a customer success platform that uses AI to score account health, flag churn risk, and identify expansion opportunities. Customer success teams use it to manage their entire portfolio from a single view, triggering automated playbooks when accounts show early warning signs. It connects to CRM, product usage data, and support tickets to build a complete picture of each customer.
